title: 第524章 收拾张雪第523章 不着急
content_zh:
第524章收拾张雪
陈楚怒气冲冲的掏出电话就要拨出去。
田晓东忙问：“小姐夫你给谁打电话？”
“我给治安局那个姓周的局长啊，他怎么办事的？”
田晓东唏嘘一声，忙拦住道：“小姐夫。您不能直接指责他啊，他毕竟是局长，正处级干部。我们需要用一个怀柔的方法。”
陈总问：“你说咋怀柔啊？”
“小姐夫，我们可以买点东西，不不不是我，我出去买两瓶茅台。大概5000块左右，然后给他送去，最好再搭上两条中华烟。”
陈楚直接打断：“你有钱啊？还是说你现在开公司赚钱了？你发达了吗？”
“我哪里发达？”田晓东支支吾吾。
陈楚指着他鼻子：“不是我说你。大学毕业之后，你找到啥正经工作了吗？从你小学一直到大学一直花父母的钱，大学毕业这才刚参加工作几天，你开第一个月工资了吗？”
“还没有。”田晓东不好意思的挠挠头，“这个工作还是小姐夫你帮我安排的。”
“是啊，我帮你安排的，第一个月工资也就3000多块，还没领到手呢，买什么茅台，买什么华子？我告诉你，你第一月工资下来之后要做什么你知道吗？”
“我知道，我给小姐夫买酒，请小姐夫吃饭。”
“胡说，小东，你第一个月工资发下来，首先要给你父母一个人买一身衣裳，哪怕是买件毛衣，多少尽尽你的孝心。然后再请父母吃顿饭，给家里买袋大米啥的，把钱花点。正地方上，别给这个买给那个买，再不就给女人花钱，那叫没有正事，不务正业。当你的事业上升成为正科级，甚至到到副处级。自然有媒婆给你介绍对象，那都踏破你家门槛子，你懂了吗？”
田晓东抿了抿嘴，低着头，想不出啥词解释了。
陈楚把电话拨了出去，直截了当：“我说老周啊，你干的好事。”
那边一紧张，他已经听说陈楚和州长汪明海称兄道弟。因为官场圈子就这么大，有点屁事大家都知知道，所以陈楚是万万得罪不起的，得罪他就等于得罪整个州的一把手，得罪了一字并肩王汪明海。他这个小局长吓破了胆也不敢忤逆一句话：“陈先生有事您吩咐。”
“我吩咐个茄子啊？你做事做的太好了，我问你李小毛是咋回事？勾结黑社会，仗势欺人，放狗行凶，然后倒打一耙，让他妈碰瓷，反倒讹受害者的钱。我出面了，给他送进去了。就这种货色又出来了？”
“是吗？”周局长那边焦急起来，“陈先生您别着急，我马上调查。”
“我告诉你，周局长，姓周的你记住了，这件事能干能查，你就给我办好，办不好我就换一个人来办，你就回家给我喂猪种地去，懂了吗？”

“明白明白。领导您稍等，我现在马上给你查。”
周局长那边放下电话，大声喝道：“给我来人呐，查查那个李小毛咋回事？谁让他放的？”
手下人蒙圈了，从来没见过局长发这么大的火，战战兢兢的开始查，最后查到，周局是一个大队长放的。
“什么？他一个大队长，谁给他的权利？那个李小毛勾结黑社会，放狗行凶。情况非常恶劣，竟然敢给我放了，把那个大队长给我铐起来。”
听到消息的大队长急急忙忙的赶到了周局长的办公室，手里还拎的茅台华子，又推过去一个厚厚的信封：“周局您别生气，这个李小毛是我远方亲戚家的孩子，三代单传就这么一独苗，做事是有些莽撞些，我在这里给您赔不是。其实呢，他也没有什么坏心思，他只是一个孩子。”

Chapter 524: Dealing with Zhang Xue
Chen Chu took out his phone angrily and was about to make a call.
Tian Xiaodong hurriedly asked: "Who are you calling, young lady?"
"I asked the director of the Public Security Bureau named Zhou, what did he do?"
Tian Xiaodong sighed and hurriedly stopped him: "My dear husband, you can't accuse him directly. After all, he is the director and a division-level cadre. We need to use a gentle approach."
Mr. Chen asked: "Why do you think you are so gentle?"
"Little husband, we can buy something. No, no, it's not me. I'll go out and buy two bottles of Maotai. It's about 5,000 yuan, and then send it to him. It's best to add two pairs of Chinese cigarettes."
Chen Chu interrupted directly: "Are you rich? Or are you making money by opening a company now? Are you prosperous?"
"Where can I get rich?" Tian Xiaodong hesitated.
Chen Chu pointed at his nose: "I'm not talking about you. After graduating from college, have you found any real job? You have been spending your parents' money from elementary school to college. You have only been working for a few days after graduating from college. Have you paid your first month's salary?"
"Not yet." Tian Xiaodong scratched his head in embarrassment, "Young lady husband arranged this job for me."
"Yes, I arranged it for you. The first month's salary is only more than 3,000 yuan. I haven't received it yet. What Maotai should I buy? What should I buy Huazi? Let me tell you, do you know what you will do after your first month's salary is paid?"
"I know, I bought wine for the young lady husband and treated the young lady husband to a meal."
"Nonsense, Xiaodong, after your first month's salary is paid, you must first buy a pair of clothes for your parents, even if it's just a sweater, and show your filial piety. Then treat your parents to a meal, buy a bag of rice for the family, and spend the money. On the right place. , Don’t buy this one for that one, and if you don’t spend money on women, that’s not doing your job properly. When your career rises to the level of a deputy director, naturally a matchmaker will introduce you to someone, and that will break the threshold of your family, do you understand?”
Tian Xiaodong pursed his lips and lowered his head, unable to think of any words to explain.
Chen Chu dialed the phone and said bluntly: "Old Zhou, you did a good job."
He was nervous there because he had heard that Chen Chu and Governor Wang Minghai were brothers. Because the official circle is so large, everyone knows about some shit, so Chen Chu cannot afford to offend him. Offending him is equivalent to offending the top leader in the entire state, offending Wang Minghai, the one-word king. He, the little director, was too frightened to say anything disobeying: "Mr. Chen, please give me your orders."
"I'm giving you an order? You've done a great job. Let me ask you, what's going on with Li Xiaomao? He colluded with the underworld, bullied others, unleashed his dogs to commit crimes, and then beat him up, letting his mother touch the porridge, and extorted the victim's money instead. I stepped forward and gave it to him. Is this kind of thing coming out again?"
"Really?" Director Zhou became anxious, "Mr. Chen, don't worry, I'll investigate right away."
"I'm telling you, Director Zhou, remember Zhou. If you can handle this matter and investigate it, you can handle it for me. If it doesn't work, I'll find someone else to handle it. You can just go home and feed my pigs and farm the land. Do you understand?"
"I understand. Leader, please wait a moment. I will check it for you right now."
Director Zhou put down the phone and shouted loudly: "Come here and find out what happened to Li Xiaomao? Who asked him to let him go?"
The subordinates were confused. They had never seen the director get so angry. They started to investigate cautiously, and finally found out that a captain of Zhou Bureau was responsible for letting him go.
"What? He is a captain, who gave him the rights? That Li Xiaomao colluded with the underworld and let the dogs out to commit crimes. The situation was so bad that he dared to let me go and handcuff the captain to me."
After hearing the news, the team leader hurried to Director Zhou's office. Maotai Huazi, still in his hand, pushed over a thick envelope: "Director Zhou, please."Don't be angry, this Li Xiaomao is the child of my distant relative. He is just a single person from three generations. He is a little reckless in his actions. I am here to apologize to you. In fact, he doesn't have any bad intentions, he is just a child. "
